hero.name: Evgeny Markov
hero.lead: I build interfaces that stay calm on the surface and predictable underneath — from campaign landings to SSR cabinets and admin tools.

about.label: About
about.title: Frontend end-to-end — from the scenario to production.
about.p1: Frontend developer with 6+ years of commercial experience (2019 — present). Focused on Vue 3, Nuxt 2/3/4, TypeScript, SPA and SSR apps, landing pages, client cabinets and admin panels.
about.p2: Agency and product-studio background: from layout and jQuery UIs to complex apps with GraphQL, headless CMS and team CI. I own features end-to-end — from design and UI scenarios to API integration and production support. Since late 2024 I use AI agents systematically, while still signing off on UI quality and release readiness.

points: Built and supported 50+ frontend projects: landings, SPA/SSR apps, cabinets and admin tools.
Owned UI end-to-end: design-stage states, layout constraints, stable production screens.
Moved legacy Gulp/Pug/jQuery stacks to Vue 3, Vite, Nuxt 3/4 and TypeScript.
Shipped Nuxt SSR/SPA, Quasar dashboards, Apollo GraphQL and JWT cabinets with Chart.js.
Worked with Docker Compose and team GitLab CI; since 2024 used AI agents with human review.
Shipped 30+ promo sites and special projects for media and brands.
Did mobile-first layout from Figma/PSD: adaptive, pixel-perfect, cross-browser.
Built interaction with GSAP, scroll effects, sliders and video players.
Optimised assets, wired analytics and Barba.js page transitions.
Built and iterated UI from layouts: HTML/Twig, SCSS, adaptive and cross-browser work.
Wrote client-side JavaScript with jQuery: menus, popups, sliders, forms.
Helped develop and maintain corporate and eCommerce frontends.
Worked in the agency website-starter: section components, styles and UI behaviour.
